name: hfd_hgi_vms_glue_sw-g2-COMMIT
purpose: OWNERS-HBM/VM-GLUE + HBM-KITS-C/VMGLUE 2026-10-18 g2 (HBM d4g plan (b), glue goes into a hardened tile): VM hub glue tile for SW (hb_vms_SW) = hfd_vms_glue_core_lt (ot_vms_hub_lt + 2 ot_vms_rstop_lt + ot_vms_rcl_lt + ot_vms_status_static: the historical glue, reset-light, parallel hub demultiplex), the 8 banks are die-level instances. Tile top hfd_hgi_vms_glue_sw_t (gen_vms_glue_tiles.py): one clock, rst_n -> ot_rst_relay 4 regions, per-bank and per-lane ring ports, one landing / relay stage on every bank-side port (COMMIT_DELAY 8). Contract vs the historical glue: bank-side ports +1 edge each way, reset release +3 (lockstep bench vs <tile>_ref).
